critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2259 lines — copilot + export endpoints should be split into routers/copilot.py and routers/exports.py.

POST /api/copilot/execute trusts client-supplied `action` payload without server-side re-validation of the tool/params against the last assistant message; a caller could execute any create_client/create_project directly, bypassing the confirmation UX. Consider signing the action or storing pending actions server-side keyed by session+action_id.
_resolve_project has a dead branch: `cl = await db.clients.find_one(...) if False else None` — leftover code should be removed.

_brand_context reads logo bytes synchronously with asyncio.to_thread per export request with no in-process cache; heavy PDF traffic will hit S3/storage repeatedly. Add TTL cache keyed by (org_id, asset_id).
In /api/copilot/message the whole workspace snapshot is passed to the LLM every turn; on large orgs this will blow the context window and cost. Consider truncation / RAG.
Frontend AICopilot.jsx should debounce rapid enter-key sends; currently a second Enter before response returns can create duplicate user messages.
